capabilities: Run Sync folder children lists from the command palette or folder-tree ribbon icon
List each folder's direct child notes and subfolders alphabetically in a callout
Link subfolders to their folder notes when one exists
Review a preview of the generated lists before approving the sync
disambiguation: Not a file manager; it only writes a Children callout listing into existing folder notes and does not move or organize files.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Folders without a folder note, hidden files, .obsidian, and the folder note itself are never listed.
intentEvidence: Sync each folder's direct children into a collapsible Children section on its folder note. Requires Folder Notes.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to keep an up-to-date list of a folder's child notes and subfolders inside a folder note.

relations.evidence: Parent notes are resolved the same way as Folder Notes

summary: Plugin that syncs each folder's direct children into a collapsible Children callout on its folder note, requiring the Folder Notes plugin.
